SUNDAY SUPPERS
Braised Beef Short Ribs
Serves 4 · Prep 20 min · Cook 3 hours
Ingredients
4 pounds bone-in beef short ribs
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
2 carrots, chopped
2 celery stalks, chopped
3 garlic cloves
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 cups red wine
2 cups beef broth
2 sprigs fresh thyme
1 bay leaf
Method
1. Season the ribs with the salt and pepper and brown them in the oil in a heavy pot, 8
 minutes. Set aside.
2. Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 1
   minute.
3. Add the wine and simmer for 5 minutes, then the broth, thyme and bay leaf.
4. Return the ribs, cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2 1/2 hours until tender.
5. Skim off the fat and serve the ribs with the sauce.

SUNDAY SUPPERS
Classic Pot Roast with Vegetables
Serves 6 · Prep 20 min · Cook 3 hours
Ingredients
3 pounds boneless beef chuck roast
1 1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1 onion, quartered
4 carrots, cut into chunks
1 1/2 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, quartered
3 garlic cloves
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 sprigs fresh rosemary
Method
1. Season the beef with the salt and pepper and brown it on all sides in the oil, 10 minutes.
2. Add the onion, garlic, broth, Worcestershire sauce and rosemary.
3. Cover and cook in a 300°F oven for 2 hours.
4. Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 1 hour more until everything is tender.
5. Slice the beef and serve with the vegetables and juices.

SUNDAY SUPPERS
Buttermilk Pancakes
Serves 4 · Ready in 20 minutes
Ingredients
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
2 cups buttermilk
2 large eggs
3 tbsp melted butter
Method
1. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
2. Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and butter, then stir into the flour until just combined.
3. Cook 1/4 cup at a time on a hot greased griddle for 2 minutes a side.

Classic Hummus
Serves 8 · Ready in 10 minutes
Ingredients
1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained
1/4 cup tahini
3 tbsp lemon juice
1 garlic clove
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
3 tbsp cold water
Method
1. Blend everything until very smooth, about 3 minutes.
2. Spread in a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve as a dip.

SUNDAY SUPPERS
Southern Sweet Tea
Serves 8 · Ready in 15 minutes, plus chilling
Ingredients
8 cups water
6 black tea bags
3/4 cup sugar
1 lemon, sliced
Method
1. Bring 4 cups of the water to a boil, add the tea bags and steep for 5 minutes.
2. Remove the bags, stir in the sugar, then the rest of the water.
3. Chill and serve over ice with the lemon.

SUNDAY SUPPERS
Chicken and Dumplings
Serves 6 · Prep 20 min · Cook 50 min
Ingredients
2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
6 cups chicken broth
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tsp salt
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp baking powder
3/4 cup milk
1 cup frozen peas
Method
1. Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 5 minutes.
2. Add the chicken, broth, thyme and salt and simmer for 25 minutes. Shred the chicken.
3. Mix the flour, baking powder and milk into a soft dough.
4. Drop spoonfuls into the simmering soup with the peas, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
5. Serve hot in bowls.
